title: Mobility Equipment Fee Notice — Assessment Fee on a Cash-Sale Chair Given Back
content:
# Assessment Fee Withheld on a Cash-Sale Chair Given Back — Mobility Equipment

**Notice.** When a Mobility Equipment chair sold for cash is given back, an assessment fee is withheld from the refund for the in-home accessibility assessments recorded on the chair: 125.00 for two or more, 75.00 for one, and nothing for none.

| In-home accessibility assessments recorded on the chair | Assessment fee withheld (USD) |
|---|---|
| none | nothing |
| one | 75.00 |
| two | 125.00 |
| three or more | 125.00 |

Every in-home accessibility assessment visit recorded on the chair counts, whatever its result.

**Hypothetical cases.** A power chair assessed once before delivery: 75.00 withheld. A power chair assessed a second time after an inaccessible first visit: 125.00 withheld, not 75.00 twice.
